scope: Read-only independent method audit of protocol, suite, revision, rubric, metadata, and v1 replay; no response or prompt edits.

findings.finding: Binary instruction-following and factual-completeness checks do not measure reader comprehension, effort, task success, or usability. Cannot establish improved communication for ADHD readers.
Development d4 requires recommending B although A and B both satisfy constraints, without a stated preference resolving cost versus speed and automation. Do not change frozen results.
Batch clustering, inherited platform style, unavailable model/sampling metadata, same-family judges, and scripted short histories limit sensitivity and generalization.
V1 development and v2 holdout have different cases and shared rules; aggregates cannot estimate revision improvement.

Verified all 24 v1 replay requests are unique and match suite. Exact pilot runtime reproduction unavailable because full inherited instructions are not preserved and system-role replay differs from task instruction and batch wrapper.
Protocol incorrectly pointed to jobs rather than replay for transport-ready message arrays; metadata omitted generation limits and availability explanation.

disposition: Protocol pointer and missing generation-limit metadata corrected after audit. Frozen prompts, cases, raw responses, and judgments retained. Measurement defects and runtime limits documented in REPORT.md.
